text:
sam.pm: dropped a small update to the role-invite flow in figma, want quick UX + engineering sanity check
julie.design: opening it now. first pass: role-first inline is clearer. concern: invite CTA color competes with role chips in the matrix
anya-ux: agree. suggestion: mute CTA to 'accent-muted' and add tiny caret to indicate a sheet/modal. make sure focus ring is prominent
max.eng: fine. prefer the role pill be the single interactive element (aria-expanded) so we don't add extra buttons for screen readers
sam.pm: SSO toggle label debate: short vs descriptive. current candidates: "SSO required" / "Require SSO for org". thoughts?
julie.design: label="SSO required" + helper: "All new members must sign in with your SSO provider." keeps the UI compact
anya-ux: link helper to toggle with aria-describedby and announce state change in a live region: "SSO requirement enabled"
max.eng: backend note: emit audit event type `sso_policy_change` with tenant_id, actor_id, before, after, request_id
audit-bot: automation reminder: audit events must include tenant_id and request_id per retention rules
sam.pm: audit log UX: users can't find invite events. proposing top filter chips with counts: [All] [Invites (12)] [SSO (2)] [Role changes (9)]
anya-ux: use roving tabindex on chips so arrows move focus; when applied announce "Invites filter applied, 12 results" via aria-live
max.eng: to avoid client-heavy counting we'll add endpoint GET /audit/summary?org_id=... returning counts per event type
julie.design: invite microcopy: change "Invite members by email" to "Invite by email — choose role before sending" and show expiry in modal: "Invitation expires in 7 days"
anya-ux: modal must trap focus and return focus to the invite CTA. role picker keyboard: Enter to open, Up/Down to navigate, Esc to cancel
max.eng: inline role edits should emit `role_inline_update` events with before/after and actor. mobile opens a bottom sheet fallback
sam.pm: small copy tweak: use "Organization members" in modals to avoid nested org ambiguity
audit-bot: deploy queue: staging after small API + event schema changes merged
julie.design: :thumbsup: i'll post updated tokens for contrast on compact row pills
anya-ux: i'll add the keyboard spec and ARIA mapping on the ticket
max.eng: i'll add API contract and example payloads to PRJ-7219, please review before EOD
